entities.summary: Catherine David is a French art historian, curator and museum director. David was the first woman and the first non-German speaker to curate documenta X in Kassel, Germany. David was deputy director and head of the Globalisation Department at the National Museum of Modern Art at the Centre Georges Pompidou.
